title: console: Monaco loads from cdn.jsdelivr.net; offline/CSP installs fall back to a textarea and log uncaught errors
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: in a container without public egress, opening any Studio source editor logged `GET https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/monaco-editor@0.55.1/min/vs/loader.js net::ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED`, "Monaco initialization: error: Event" ×2 and six uncaught `Event` page errors.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

`useMonacoFallback` falls back to a textarea as designed, so editing still works, but private or strict-CSP installs lose highlighting and completion, and the rejected loader leaks uncaught errors.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Bundle Monaco with the console (`loader.config({ monaco })`) and serve it from the console's own assets; catch the loader rejection.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.
